about_the_game:
You are a human. You will inspect this Office Creation, intended for human use, and report the number of anomalies you find. 

Correct answers progress you to the next stage. Complete all stages for Ascension.

Incorrect answers will result in death.

content_descriptors.notes: There are some scenes showing people in distress, such as hanging upside down and bleeding.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+ (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 / AMD FX series or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 450 / AMD equivalent with 2GB+ of Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 4650 / AMD FX-8320 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 2070 / AMD equivalent with 4GB+ of Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: The anomalies are watching. Tally them, trust in your team and Ascend - before they start hunting you.
